reviews.title: LIFETIME MEMBERSHIP NOT HONURED
reviews.text:
I purchased the lifetime family membership five years ago, and it worked perfectly with no ads. Recently, the app began showing a large number of advertisements every time I open it, and my purchase is no longer being recognized. Several features are also locked.

I contacted customer service four months ago, and they promised to restore my purchase. Nothing has happened since then. I have sent multiple follow-up emails and have received no response.

It appears that after the app moved to a new version, customers who bought lifetime memberships years ago can no longer use the app as originally promised. A lifetime purchase should mean exactly that. This is unacceptable, and I hope the company will restore my access without further delay.

reviews.title: Quran part of the app not working but Still the Best Prayer Timing App After Years of Use
reviews.text:
Update: my Quran part of the app stop working no response from the developer

Old review: 
I have been using Athan Pro for several years now, and it remains hands-down the best prayer timing app I’ve ever tried. Over the years I’ve sampled many prayer apps, but none of them match the quality, features, and long-term reliability of Athan Pro. This app has become an integral part of my daily routine – a trusted companion that has never let me down when it comes to prayer schedules and reminders. The tone of my review is nothing but sincere, because Athan Pro has truly earned my appreciation after such extended use.

Unmatched Reliability Over Years

One of the standout aspects of Athan Pro is its unmatched reliability. In all the time I’ve used it, the app has performed flawlessly with virtually zero crashes or glitches. Every update has only improved the experience without compromising stability. I love that I can depend on Athan Pro whether I’m at home or traveling; it automatically adjusts to new locations and still delivers precise prayer times. Having used it through different iOS versions and iPhone models, I can confidently say the quality and consistency of this app are unparalleled – no other app in this category comes close to its rock-solid performance.

Flawless on iPhone and Apple Watch

Athan Pro works perfectly on both my iPhone and Apple Watch, which is a huge plus. The iPhone app is smooth and responsive, and the Apple Watch companion app is just as dependable.

reviews.title: Lifetime premium subscription revoked
reviews.text:
Like so many others, I have been a LIFETIME premium subscription user; since 2018; and like so many others, my LIFETIME premium subscription was recently revoked.

When I reached out, the team cited rising server costs, but said my account would be reinstated due to my longstanding loyalty. After more than two months and many follow up emails, like so many others, I too have been ghosted. 

Reading through the reviews confirms this seems to be a recurring theme. This is completely unacceptable, let alone for Muslims. It’s outright stealing. It’s illegal, ethically immoral and in violation of Apple Developer Review Guidelines and Australian Consumer Law. You can’t just revoke a LIFETIME premium subscription citing server costs and expect those same longstanding premium users who helped you get to where you are to pay more.

I’ve reported this as fraud through Apple’s ecosystem and will be following up with ACCC.

reviews.title: Stay away - highly unethical conduct
reviews.text: I’ve been a long-time premium user of this app, along with my family, and had paid specifically to remove ads many years ago. I was taken aback to find that on the first night of Ramadan, the app had become unusable because of a flood of ads for Chinese retail outlets kicking in every few seconds, making it impossible to do anything or see prayer times. I tried to restore my purchases, but found the developer had turned this feature off. I emailed to ask about this, and was sent a boilerplate email telling me that they had basically decided to downgrade me without telling me, for no clear reason (something about free upgrades rolled out in the past?). In other words, this developer took money from me for a specific feature (to remove ads) and then decided to restore the ads and expect me to pay more money for the privilege of reacquiring the service I’d already paid for. They then ignored any follow-up questions. Bear in mind they timed this to start with Ramadan. I’ve not met a more cynical, unethical ploy in many years on the App Store, and it’s grotesque it’s coming from a company offering prayer timings. I don’t see how this isn’t fraudulent behavior because I paid for a permanent upgrade and they’ve quietly removed that upgrade. So I’ve basically deleted this app from all my family’s devices and have moved on to other prayer timings apps, of which there are plenty, thankfully. reviews.title: Abonnement à vie supprimé le premier jour du Ramadan. Honte.
reviews.text:
J’ai payé un abonnement Premium à vie en 2017. Le mot important c’est à vie. Pas “jusqu’à ce que ça vous arrange”. Pas “jusqu’à ce que vous décidiez de changer les règles”. À vie.

Et vous n’avez rien trouvé de mieux que de me retirer cet abonnement le premier jour du Ramadan. Après des années d’utilisation quotidienne pour consulter les horaires de prière. Le timing est juste indécent.

C’est une trahison pure et simple.

Vous avez encaissé l’argent, profité de la fidélité des utilisateurs, puis supprimé un engagement contractuel sans aucun respect. Pour un musulman, la parole donnée a une valeur immense. Manifestement, pour vous, elle ne vaut rien.

J’ai contacté le service client à plusieurs reprises. Aucune solution. Aucune explication claire. Aucune responsabilité. Juste du vide.

C’est malhonnête.

Je vais également arrêter mon abonnement Quran Pro. Je refuse de soutenir des applications qui ne respectent pas leurs propres promesses.

Je déconseille fortement l’abonnement Premium. Ne vous laissez pas piéger par le “à vie”. Apparemment, chez eux, “à vie” ne signifie rien.

Application à éviter. Manque total d’éthique et de respect envers ses utilisateurs.
